mapper.select: select r.*, (select count(*) from information_schema.columns c where c.table_schema=database() and c.table_name='biz_contract_fee_plan' and c.column_name in ('receivable_amount','received_amount','confirm_status','invoice_status') and (c.column_name not in ('receivable_amount','received_amount') or (c.numeric_precision=14 and c.numeric_scale=2))) fee_plan_core_column_count, (select count(*) from information_schema.columns c where c.table_schema=database() and c.table_name='biz_contract_fee_plan' and c.column_name in ('trigger_type','trigger_node_code','trigger_business_id','collection_owner_id','due_rule_json','risk_fee_calc_id')) node_fee_column_count, (select count(*) from information_schema.tables t where t.table_schema=database() and t.table_name in ('biz_receivable_trigger','biz_collection_record','biz_refund')) finance_support_table_count, ((select count(*) from information_schema.tables t where t.table_schema=database() and t.table_name='biz_risk_fee_calculation') + (select count(*) from information_schema.columns c where c.table_schema=database() and c.table_name='biz_contract' and c.column_name in ('risk_agency_flag','risk_base','risk_ratio'))) risk_schema_object_count from todo_foundation_finance_requirement r where r.gate_code=#{gateCode} order by r.sort_order,r.requirement_id
